comments.body: Hi, all of this greatly depends on your POI. Usually they do conduct interviews. IIRC, the decisions are usually sent out shortly before the master‘s decisions are sent out if you‘re accepted (I think back then for me it was the end of February). If not, at that point, the application portal will say that you applied to Master‘s. Also the acceptance rate greatly varies based on your POI as it depends on whether they need new students. One year only a handful of students are accepted while in another year around ten are accepted, so it varies but it’s definitely not a lot of students that get accepted.
comments.author: Traveller-2001
